description: Find coin records by multiple hints at once. Batch version of get_coin_records_by_hint. Optionally filter by spent status and height range. ⚠️ Coinset-hosted-node extension — not available on a local chia-blockchain node or the simulator.

end_height.description: Only return coins created before this height

hints.description: Array of hints to search for (0x-prefixed hex strings)

include_spent_coins.description: Include coins that have been spent (default: false)

start_height.description: Only return coins created at or after this height

name: get_coin_records_by_hints
